text: FOL ::: ∀x (Sport(x) ∧ PlayedBetweenTwoTeams(x) ∧ PlayedOnAField(x) ∧ UsesABall(x) ∧ ObjectiveIsToScorePoints(x) ∧ ObjectiveIsToGetBallIntoOpposingTeamGoal(x) → GoalBasedSport(x)) ::: A sport that is played between two teams on a field with a ball and the objective is to score points by getting the ball into the opposing team's goal is a goal-based sport.
